summary: The workflow has blocking execution and approval-handling defects despite passing unit tests.
issues: Browser QA is always configured with start_url='/' and never uses the discovered Vercel preview URL. Playwright requires an absolute URL, so the integrated pipeline fails at Browser QA before reaching READY_TO_COMMIT (automation/main.py:239, automation/main.py:265).

A rejected push approval is ignored when an earlier commit approval exists: the code selects the latest approved record rather than honoring the newest decision. It re-enters COMMITTING and can issue another push approval instead of transitioning to REJECTED_BY_USER (automation/main.py:77).
After explicit push approval, PUSHING prints that push is skipped but sets COMPLETED, falsely reporting a successful push (automation/main.py:322).
evidence: python -m unittest discover -s automation/tests -v: 99 tests passed.
The preview result is saved but discarded (automation/main.py:229-230); BrowserQAScenario is later built with the relative root path (automation/main.py:239-253).
next_instruction: Carry the verified preview URL into BrowserQAScenario and fail closed when no READY URL exists; resolve approvals by their newest decision and handle rejection explicitly; do not mark PUSHING complete unless a real, verified push occurs. Add integration tests for each flow.
